summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in cors-version@1.0.1
details: cors-version@1.0.1 contains 3 scanned files and no behaviors matching supply-chain attack patterns were identified. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profile stores), no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data, no self-propagation or publish-token harvesting, and no backdoor mechanism are present. The package name resembles common CORS-related utilities, but name resemblance alone is not a threat indicator and no malicious code path was found in this version.
